info.name: GarageOne Customer and Vehicle APIs
info.description: Organized by API area. To test service booking to estimate: run Service Booking - Create booking, Service Booking - List bookings, Service Booking - Activity - Proceed to Jobcard, then Service Estimate - List estimates. Set the booking registration/mobile and valid make/model IDs first.

item.name: Customer and Vehicle - Staged creation flow
item.description: Run in order. Search checks both values and reports whether they identify the same linked customer and vehicle. If matched is true, reuse both IDs. If only the customer exists, create its vehicle. If neither exists, create the customer first and then create the vehicle. If the registration is already used outside the current outlet, vehicleExists is true while vehicle details are withheld; do not attempt to create it again.

request.description: Returns all workflow statuses for the current user and outlet. statusCounts keys: Initiated (status 1), In Progress (2), Ready for Billing (3), Billing (4), Delivered (5), Cancelled (6). Each row includes displayStatus; status/status_value retain legacy values.

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.
Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

request.description: Use the selected lineItemCode from results.labour (laborCode for LABOUR/OSL, itemCode for PART). modelSegment is required for labour pricing. Single-item requests remain supported.

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

request.description: Use the selected lineItemCode from results.parts (laborCode for LABOUR/OSL, itemCode for PART).

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

request.description: Use the selected lineItemCode from results.osl (laborCode for LABOUR/OSL, itemCode for PART).

item.name: Job Card - Save labour, OSL, and parts

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

request.description: Template adds new Job Card labour and part records as PENDING. For updates, include each existing Job Card line id. Send the complete current labor, oslLabor, and parts arrays: omitted saved lines are deleted. Existing line approval is preserved. Do not send estimateId or call Service Estimate update APIs from the Job Card flow.

item.name: Job Card - Approve or reject one line

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

request.description: Approve/reject each PART, LABOUR, or OSL line separately. When all existing lines across all three types are approved, status 1 automatically advances to status 2 (Work In Progress). Approved estimate lines copied into a JC are already marked approved.

item.name: Line Items - Get selected labour, parts, and OSL details together

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

request.description: Fetches all selected item details in one request. Replace each sample code with the selected laborCode/itemCode from search results. modelSegment is required when at least one LABOUR item is selected. This fetch does not save the items to the estimate.

item.name: 4 - Estimate Approval
item.description: Estimate sharing, PDF, and service-advisor approval requests.

item.name: Service Estimate - Approve by service advisor

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

item.description: Stores advisor ID/name and approval time. A later estimate edit resets advisor approval to pending; customer approval remains TBD.

item.name: Service Estimate - Share via WhatsApp

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

item.description: Generates and uploads the latest estimate PDF, then returns a wa.me link. Opening the link lets the user send the prepared estimate message.

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

request.description: Regenerates the PDF from the latest estimate data, uploads it to the same GCS object for this estimate (overwriting the previous PDF), and returns the PDF download. The refreshed signed cloud URL is in the X-Estimate-Pdf-Url response header.

item.name: Job Card - Create from approved estimate

header.description: Raw JWT token; do not prefix with Bearer.

item.description: Converts an approved estimate into a job card and creates its labour, OSL, and parts schedule records. The pre-request script reads userId from authToken; estimateId must identify an estimate approved by a service advisor for this outlet.
